purpose: Separate PNG layers for O2 mask and peripheral IV — composited onto patient portraits instead of burning slop into base gens.

devices.label: Adult medium-concentration O2 face mask

anatomy.maskBody: Clear soft vinyl; covers nose and mouth; standard (not elongated aerosol) adult face mask
anatomy.noseClip: Malleable metal nose clip molded into upper rim
anatomy.elasticStrap: Single green or white elastic head strap through side tabs — ONE strap only
anatomy.connector: Single molded plastic barbed port at bottom center of mask (22 mm standard)
anatomy.tubing: ONE continuous clear Star Lumen oxygen supply tube (~7 ft) attached to bottom port — never duplicate parallel tubes from same port
forbidden: non-rebreather reservoir bag unless explicitly requested
fantasy mesh or rubber diving mask shape

devices.compositeUse: Face zone — mask only layer + optional tubing exit frame edge

devices.label: Peripheral IV — BD Insyte-class winged catheter at antecubital fossa

anatomy.site: Antecubital fossa — inner elbow volar crease ONLY
anatomy.catheterHub: Transparent wings (T-shaped or butterfly wings) with visible 18–22g catheter hub at insertion
anatomy.needle: Needle removed post-insertion — hub only with flashback chamber appearance
anatomy.tape: Two strips transparent Tegaderm-style tape crossing hub — not floating gray smudges
anatomy.extensionSet: Single clear IV extension tubing from hub, one luer connection, runs proximally along forearm toward bed/pole

devices.compositeUse: zone-arm overlay — masked to antecubital only
